mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when GDPC1 rises for 3 months, or IC <0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 2.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive despite UNRATE <2.5% in 20d, or IC >0.05 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals expanding economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise, or IC <0.03 over 3mo window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% during a monetary tightening cycle triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in tightening cycle despite FEDFUNDS >5%, or IC <0.05 over 6mo window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in GDP (GDPC1) during an economic expansion phase predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 rising but 60d returns not positive, or IC <0.03 over 1yr.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the supply index (INDPRO) above 110.0 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 110 but 5d returns negative, or IC <0.1 over 1mo.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in labor demand (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when PAYEMS up and UNRATE down, or IC <0.03 over 6mo.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in demand indicator (HOUST) below 1200 units during a late-cycle expansion predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST below 1200 in late-cycle but returns negative, or IC <0.05 over 1yr.
